cases.claim_refuted: Width-three pairwise XOR closure detects every inconsistent system of width-three equations.
cases.explanation: Each variable occurs twice, so summing all four rows gives 0=1. Every distinct pair overlaps in exactly one variable, making its sum width four: width three retains no new row. Removing any row makes the system satisfiable.

cases.claim_refuted: Wider XOR closure is always at least as effective under the same pair-attempt budget.
cases.explanation: At 33 pair attempts, width two refutes this six-variable cycle; width four spends attempts on extra relations and stops before refutation. The gap depends on this deterministic scheduling and budget, not unsoundness or unrestricted closure strength.
